verse.text: So let’s not get tired of doing what is good. At just the right time we will reap a harvest of blessing if we don’t give up.

video.title: Do Good & Leave the Rest to God | Galatians 6:9–10 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Fatherhood is a long harvest, not an instant one — the bedtime routines, the coaching, the quiet corrections rarely feel like they're 'working' in the moment. Galatians 6:9 is God's reminder that the seeds you plant in your kids today, even when you're exhausted, are still growing underground. Don't quit the good, unglamorous work of showing up; the harvest comes at the right time, not always on your timetable.
